summary_en: Ridge-i Inc. authorized acquisition of up to 160,000 shares (3.6% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥450 million via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between September 24 and November 30, 2026, to support flexible capital allocation and employee stock incentive programs.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 17, 2026, Ridge-i Inc.'s board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock pursuant to the Company's Articles of Incorporation and the Companies Act. The acquisition will cover up to 160,000 ordinary shares, representing 3.6% of outstanding shares (calculated from 4,344,364 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026), for a maximum expenditure of ¥450 million.

The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from September 24, 2026, through November 30, 2026. The company stated that the acquisition serves two purposes: to enable flexible capital allocation policy responsive to changes in the business environment, and to secure and retain talented personnel through equity-based compensation programs. As of August 31, 2026, the company held 76 treasury shares.
